entities.summary: Krzysztof Maciej Zwarycz is a Polish male weightlifter, competing in the 77 kg category and representing Poland at international competitions. He participated at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the 77 kg event. He competed at world championships, most recently at the 2011 World Weightlifting Championships.
